sb.name: Abomination
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Reeking Corpse
traits.desc: The abomination emits an aura of toxic rot in a 20-foot Emanation. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, any creature that starts its turn in the Emanation. Failure: 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The abomination makes two Cleaver attacks and one Crush attack. It can replace any attack with a Throw Flesh attack.

actions.name: Cleaver
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Crush
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two arms. While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Throw Flesh
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Consume Life
bonus_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature Grappled by the abomination. Failure: 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the abomination regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

sb.name: Aku'mai
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, unconscious
sb.languages: understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: Aku'mai can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.desc: If Aku'mai fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.desc: For each head Aku'mai has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.

traits.name: Tearing the Void (2/Day)
traits.desc: Aku'mai has three heads. If it would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, its current Hit Point total instead resets to 149 Hit Points, it recharges its Caustic Bile, it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance, and one of its remaining heads dies. Additionally, it can now use one of the options in "Mythic Actions" for 1 hour. Award the characters an additional 3,900 XP for defeating Aku'mai after the first time its Tearing the Void activates and an additional 3,900 XP after the second time (11,700 XP total).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Aku'mai makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Caustic Bile (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point Aku'mai can see within 30 feet. Failure: 9 (2d8) Acid damage, and 4 (1d8) Acid damage at the end of its next turn. Success: Half the initial damage only.

legendary_actions.name: Bite
legendary_actions.desc: Aku'mai makes one Bite attack.

legendary_actions.name: Quake Cavern
legendary_actions.desc: Aku'mai causes the earth to quake and rocks to fall from above. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature within 30 feet of Aku'mai. Failure: 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Aku'mai can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

mythic_actions.desc: If Aku'mai's Tearing the Void has activated in the last hour, it can use one of the options below as a Legendary Action. The first time Tearing the Void activates, Aku'mai gains access to Void Body; the second time, it gains access to Song of Ny'alotha.

mythic_actions.name: Void Body
mythic_actions.desc: Aku'mai's body extrudes a phantasmal tentacle of its true void form. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature Aku'mai can see within 30 feet. Failure: 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains 1 level of Exhaustion.

mythic_actions.name: Song of Ny'alotha
mythic_actions.desc: Aku'mai wails an otherworldly song. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature Aku'mai can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Unconscious condition until the end of its next turn, which ends early if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. Failure or Success: Aku'mai can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

sb.name: Alleria Windrunner
sb.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness), passive Perception 30

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If Alleria fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Whispers of the Void
traits.desc: Alleria emanates an aura in a 10-foot Emanation while she doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 21, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Alleria makes four attacks, using Void Dagger or Windrunner's Bow in any combination.

actions.name: Void Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d4 + 6) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Windrunner's Bow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +13, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Grasp of Emptiness (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 21, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point Alleria can see within 120 feet. Failure: 55 (10d10) Psychic damage. Until the end of the target's next turn, the target's Speed is halved; the target can't take Reactions; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Void Stealth
bonus_actions.desc: While in Dim Light or Darkness, Alleria can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness. She then has the Invisible condition until the start of her next turn.

reactions.name: Spatial Rift
reactions.desc: Trigger: Alleria is hit by an attack roll. Response: Alleria halves the damage (round down) she takes from that attack and then teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet.

sb.name: Alzzin the Wildshaper

traits.name: Fel Wildshape (2/Day)
traits.desc: If Alzzin would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, his current Hit Point total instead resets to 200 Hit Points, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, he can now use one of the options in "Mythic Actions" for 1 hour. The first time he uses it, he transforms into a Huge bear; award the characters an additional 10,000 XP for defeating him in this form. The second time he uses it, he transforms into a Large wolf; award the characters an additional 10,000 XP for defeating him in this form (30,000 XP total). Except for his size and Mythic Actions, his game statistics are unchanged when he shape-shifts.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Alzzin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Alzzin makes two Fel Claw attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Enervation and the other with a use of Wither.

actions.name: Fel Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Enervation
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, one creature within 60 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage. If the target can cast spells, it can't use level 1 spell slots until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Wither
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, one creature within 60 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 1d8 from its damage rolls until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Claw
legendary_actions.desc: Alzzin makes one Fel Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Fel Inferno
legendary_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from Alzzin. Failure: 10 (3d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: Alzzin can't use this action again until the start of his next turn.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

mythic_actions.desc: If Alzzin's Fel Wildshape has activated in the last hour, he can use one of the options below as a Legendary Action. The first time Fel Wildshape activates, Alzzin gains access to Wrath of Mardum; the second time, he gains access to Alacrity of Xoroth.

mythic_actions.name: Wrath of Mardum (Bear Form Only)
mythic_actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) Fire damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet straight away from Alzzin and drops one object of its choice that it's holding in the space it was pushed out of. For 1 minute, the object is wreathed in green flames and any creature holding the object has Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

mythic_actions.name: Alacrity of Xoroth (Wolf Form Only)
mythic_actions.desc: Alzzin moves up to 60 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each time Alzzin enters a creature's space for the first time during this move, that target is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: 10 (3d6) Slashing damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The ancient deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ancient makes three attacks, using Slam or Hurl Lightning in any combination.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 34 (4d12 + 8) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hurl Lightning
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 500 ft. Hit: 37 (6d10 + 4) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Nature's Fury (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder originating from a point the ancient can see within 200 feet. Failure: 27 (5d10) Piercing damage plus 55 (10d10) Lightning damage, and the target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions until the start of the ancient's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If Anduin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Anduin makes four attacks, using Shalamayne or Holy Fire in any combination.

actions.name: Shalamayne
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) Slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) Force damage.

actions.name: Holy Fire
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +11, range 120 ft. Hit: 16 (3d10) Fire damage plus 16 (3d10) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Volley (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Anduin unleashes a wave of radiant energy in a 60-foot Emanation, restoring 45 (7d12) Hit Points to himself or an ally he can see in the Emanation. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, each enemy in the Emanation. Failure: 45 (7d12) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Anduin casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Daylight|Daylight]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|Dispel Evil and Good]], [[Tools/Spells/Zone Of Truth|Zone of Truth]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|Raise Dead]], [[Tools/Spells/Sunburst|Sunburst]]

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid
bonus_actions.desc: Anduin casts [[Tools/Spells/Bless|Bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], or [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|Greater Restoration]], using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Power Word: Shield
reactions.desc: Trigger: Anduin is hit by an attack roll. Response: Anduin gains 25 Temporary Hit Points.

sb.name: Anub'arak
sb.speed: 50 ft., burrow 50 ft., climb 50 ft., fly 30 ft.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If Anub'arak fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Swarm Aura
traits.desc: Anub'arak emanates a swarm of undead insects in a 10-foot Emanation while he doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. At the end of each of Anub'arak's turns, each creature in the Emanation takes 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.desc: If damage reduces Anub'arak to 0 Hit Points, he makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, Anub'arak drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Anub'arak makes two attacks using Icy Claw or Crypt Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Icy Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (2d12 + 8) Slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) Cold damage.

actions.name: Crypt Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +14, range 120 ft. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) Cold damage plus 13 (2d12) Necrotic damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 20 feet until the start of Anub'arak's next turn.

reactions.name: Submerge (1/Day)
reactions.desc: Trigger: Anub'arak becomes Bloodied or takes damage while Bloodied. Response: Anub'arak moves up to his Burrow Speed into the ground. While underground, he has Total Cover from attacks and other effects outside the earth, and he regains 30 Hit Points at the start of each of his turns. He emerges on his turn when he reaches his Hit Point maximum or if all his allies within 120 feet of him are killed.

legendary_actions.name: Crypt Bolt
legendary_actions.desc: Anub'arak makes one Crypt Bolt attack.

legendary_actions.name: Earth Spike
legendary_actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 22, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point on an earthen surface within 60 feet of Anub'arak. Failure: 28 (8d6) Piercing damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Arcane Bubble (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: If Doan would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, his current Hit Point total instead resets to 165 Hit Points, he has Immunity to all damage until the start of his next turn, and he regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, he can now use the Detonate action and the Anti-Spell Tome Bonus Action for 1 hour. Award the characters an additional 5,900 XP (11,800 XP total) for defeating Doan after his Arcane Bubble activates.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If Doan fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Doan has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Doan makes three Arcane Explosion attacks and uses Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|Polymorph]] if available.

actions.name: Arcane Explosion
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Detonate (Requires Arcane Bubble; Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature of Doan's choice within a 60-foot Emanation originating from him. Failure: 38 (7d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Doan casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included in AC), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|Polymorph]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Prismatic Spray|Prismatic Spray]]

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step
bonus_actions.desc: Doan teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet.

bonus_actions.name: Anti-Spell Tome (Requires Arcane Bubble)
bonus_actions.desc: Doan summons a floating tome in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of himself. The spellbook is an object that has AC 20, HP 25, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, and a Fly Speed of 20 feet, and it automatically succeeds on saving throws. Creatures other than Doan within 10 feet of the tome can't take the Magic action.

sb.name: Baron Ashbury
sb.speed: 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (see Dark Archangel Form)

traits.name: Dark Archangel Form (Recharges After a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: If Ashbury would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, his current Hit Point total instead resets to 82 Hit Points. He also gains a Fly Speed of 30 feet. Additionally, he can now use the option in "Mythic Actions" for 1 hour. Award the characters an additional 1,100 XP (2,200 XP total) for defeating Ashbury after his Dark Archangel Form activates.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ashbury makes two Pain Blast attacks.

actions.name: Pain Blast
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Asphyxiate (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature of Ashbury's choice within 30 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

legendary_actions.name: Wracking Pain
legendary_actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature Ashbury can see within 30 feet. Failure: 4 (1d8) Psychic damage.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

mythic_actions.desc: If Baron Ashbury's Dark Archangel Form has activated in the last hour, he can use the option below as a Legendary Action.

mythic_actions.name: Calamity
mythic_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature of Ashbury's choice in a 10-foot Emanation originating from him. Failure: 4 (1d8) Psychic damage. Failure or Success: Ashbury can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

sb.name: Baron Silverlaine
sb.damage_resistances: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: Silverlaine can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. He takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if he ends his turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Silverlaine makes one Object Slam attack and uses Telekinetic Thrust.

actions.name: Object Slam
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Telekinetic Thrust
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature Silverlaine can see within 30 feet. Failure: 9 (2d6 + 2) Force damage, and the target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from Silverlaine.

legendary_actions.name: Cursed Veil
legendary_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature Silverlaine can see within 30 feet. Failure: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Odo's Blinding Shadows
legendary_actions.desc: The spirit of Odo the Blindwatcher hurls shadows at a foe. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature Silverlaine can see within 60 feet. Failure: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of Silverlaine's next turn. Failure or Success: Silverlaine can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Rethilgore's Soul Drain
legendary_actions.desc: The spirit of Rethilgore feasts on an enemy's soul. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature Silverlaine can see within 60 feet. Failure: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of Silverlaine's next turn. Failure or Success: Silverlaine can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Proficiency Bonus
traits.desc: Your Proficiency Bonus doesn't change.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: You make two Mangle attacks.

actions.name: Mangle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + your Wisdom modifier Slashing damage. This damage increases by 1d8 when you reach Druid levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

bonus_actions.name: Frenzied Regeneration
bonus_actions.desc: You expend a level 1+ spell slot and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to five times the spell slot level.

reactions.name: Growl
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you. Response: You impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll and all other attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn if you remain within 5 feet of the target.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce

Failure or Success: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn, and the ground in the affected area becomes molten for 1 minute.
